rule: Archive-only projects stay external. HoloVerse recognizes them read-only by responder metadata or conservative aliases, anywhere up to three folders deep inside Prototype Lab or MatrixCore Project (282.50), so a project can be moved without breaking its link; explicit LINK SIMULATION creates persistent identity/recovery state.

projects.title: HoloCore
projects.description: External HoloCore reality. Found anywhere in Prototype Lab or MatrixCore Project and mounted through its own folder-local native adapter; no HoloCore scene code lives inside HoloVerse.

projects.title: Mirror's Limbo
projects.description: Mirror's liminal social-stealth reality. Native responder projects remain external and launch in the shared HoloVerse Panda3D window.

projects.title: Vector Arena
projects.description: External HoloVerse wave/horde combat reality, kept inside Utopia Conflict. Found anywhere in Prototype Lab through its portable responder and mounted in the shared Panda3D window; TAB always returns to HoloVerse.

projects.title: Glyphbound
projects.description: External Glyphbound reality. HoloVerse discovers a sibling or pass-numbered Glyphbound main.py without copying the project; raw builds use the compatibility lifecycle, while responder/native-adapter builds can promote to the shared HoloVerse Panda3D lifecycle.
projects.missing_issue: Glyphbound source not linked — select its main.py to restore access

projects.title: The Indigo Giant
projects.description: An archive of the past Gleebs carried into HoloVerse: REDACTED, the dying desert world where Nyx and Orbit walked before they came home with him. Crimson stayed behind. Native same-window reality; TAB returns to HoloVerse.

projects.title: Utopia Conflict // Source Vector Arena
projects.description: Utopia Conflict, the full-source war for the Utopia that Vector Arena grew out of. Native same-window reality kept inside Utopia Vision; TAB returns to HoloVerse.

projects.title: Afterlife of IO
projects.description: IO's afterlife, between the Beginning and the Present: seven Memory Guardians, seven lost civilization archives, and the Veil at the end. Opens in its own window (pygame); Return to HoloVerse from its menus brings you back.
